value.text:
We need to evaluate each claim against the evidence. The claims are numbered 1-11. We must check if each claim is fully supported by the cited evidence IDs. If any claim has factual problems (overstatements, wrong numbers, dates, suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence), we flag it in unsupported list with claim text, agent, and why.

We must output JSON with key "unsupported" containing list of objects. If all supported, empty list.

Let's examine each claim.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-4279-02 is listed on the FDA shortage list as "Available" updated 10/21/2026." Cited: [shortage-0409-4279-02]. Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Lidocaine Hydrochloride, Injection, 300 mg/30 mL (1%; 10 mg/mL) (NDC 0409-4279-02) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Available"; updated 10/21/2026". This matches exactly. So claim 1 supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock is 394 units covering 13.6 days at 29 units per day, with a backordered order of 325 units expected 2026-10-24." Cited: [stock-2]. Evidence: "lidocaine LIDOCAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 10 mg/mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-4279-02, ANDA088329): 394 units on hand, 29/day over 30 days, 13.6 days of cover; open orders: PO-SAMPLE-002 backordered 325 units from Cardinal Health, expected 2026-10-24". Matches. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC." Cited: [recall-D-1815-2015]. Evidence: "FDA recall D-1815-2015 (Class II, ongoing) by Hospira, Inc.: Presence of Particulate Matter: particulate matter identified as iron oxide, was found embedded in the neck of glass vials." The evidence does not mention whether the recall notice lists our NDC. The claim says "but the recall notice does not list our NDC." The evidence does not provide that information. The recall notice may or may not list the NDC. The evidence only describes the recall reason. The claim makes an assertion about the recall notice not listing our NDC, which is not supported by the evidence. This is a factual problem: the evidence does not state that the recall notice does not list our NDC. So claim 3 is unsupported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current lidocaine 10 mg/mL from Hospira has 13.6 days of cover and an open order backordered until 2026-10-24." Cited: [stock-2]. Evidence shows 13.6 days of cover and open order backordered expected 2026-10-24. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "Current product is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) per Orange Book." Cited: [ob-ANDA088329-001]. Evidence: "Orange Book: LIDOCAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 1% (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application ANDA088329, TE code AP (our current product)". This matches. Supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "ANDA208474 is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [ob-ANDA208474-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, status-ANDA208474]. Evidence: ob-ANDA208474-001 shows TE code AP for ANDA208474. ob-ANDA088329-001 shows TE code AP for current product. Both have TE code AP, which indicates therapeutic equivalence. The claim says "therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP)" - that is supported. status-ANDA208474 says: "Checked B BRAUN MEDICAL INC ANDA208474: 1 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing (0264-9376-88 by B. Braun Medical Inc.: not on the FDA shortage list); no ongoing recall on these products. Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." This supports "none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." So claim 6 supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "ANDA217692 is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [ob-ANDA217692-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, status-ANDA217692]. Evidence: ob-ANDA217692-001 shows TE code AP. ob-ANDA088329-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA217692 says: "Checked MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217692: 8 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing ... not on the FDA shortage list ... Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." Supported.

Claim 8: substitution: "ANDA217693 is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [ob-ANDA217693-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, status-ANDA217693]. Evidence: ob-ANDA217693-001 shows TE code AP. ob-ANDA088329-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA217693 says: "Checked MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217693: 8 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing ... not on the FDA shortage list ... Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." Supported.

Claim 9: substitution: "B BRAUN MEDICAL INC ANDA208474: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA208474, ob-ANDA208474-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-0264-9376]. This is essentially same as claim 6 but with additional ndc-0264-9376. The evidence supports therapeutic equivalence and none on shortage list. The ndc-0264-9376 provides NDC directory info but not needed. The claim is supported.

Claim 10: substitution: "MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217692: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217692, ob-ANDA217692-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-72603-350, ndc-70756-641, ndc-70756-640]. Evidence supports therapeutic equivalence and none on shortage list. The NDC directory records list packages but not shortage status. The status record already says none on shortage list. So claim supported.

Claim 11: substitution: "MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217693: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217693, ob-ANDA217693-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-70756-645, ndc-70756-644, ndc-70756-646]. Similarly supported.

Thus only claim 3 is unsupported.

We need to output JSON with unsupported list containing claim 3.

Format: {"unsupported":[{"claim":string,"agent":"investigator"|"substitution","why":string}]}

For claim 3, agent is "investigator". The claim text: "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC." The why: "The cited recall evidence does not state whether the recall notice lists our NDC; it only describes the recall reason."

We'll include that.

(recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC.","agent":"investigator","why":"The cited recall evidence does not state whether the recall notice lists our NDC; it only describes the recall reason."}]}
